title: Adjectives: words that describe nouns
examples: What is the difference between taller and tallest?

explain.say: Imagine I say: I saw a dog. Now imagine: I saw a huge, fluffy, golden dog. Can you see it better now? Huge, fluffy and golden are adjectives, words that describe a noun. Look at the size box on the board: huge, tiny, tall.

explain.say: Some adjectives tell you a colour. See the colour box? Red, golden, green. A red kite, a golden sunset. What colour is your bag?

explain.say: Now the feel or taste box: soft, spicy, sticky. A spicy curry, a sticky mango. And the last box shows feelings: a brave girl, a sleepy baby. Which adjective describes you today?

explain.say: Adjectives can also compare. Look at the board: tall plus er makes taller, for two things. Amir is taller than his sister. Can you compare two fruits? A melon is bigger than a lime.
Super! Now add est: tallest, the most of all, for three or more. The giraffe is the tallest animal on Earth. Wow fact: good and bad are rule-breakers: good, better, best, and bad, worse, worst!

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: est means the most of all

faq.a: An adjective is a describing word that tells you more about a noun, like a huge dog, a red kite or a brave girl.

faq.q: What is the difference between taller and tallest?
faq.a: Taller compares two things: Amir is taller than Sara. Tallest compares three or more: Amir is the tallest in the family.

faq.q: Why is it better and not gooder?
faq.a: Good is irregular: good, better, best. Bad is too: bad, worse, worst. These come from very old English words.

faq.q: When do I use more instead of er?
faq.a: For most long adjectives use more and most: more beautiful, most exciting. Short words take er and est: faster, fastest.

faq.q: Where does an adjective go in a sentence?
faq.a: Usually just before the noun, as in a spicy curry, or after a verb like is, as in the curry is spicy.
asks: Does the adjective go before the noun?

facts: The giraffe is the tallest living land animal, up to about 5.5 metres.
In Spanish and French most adjectives come after the noun, as in casa blanca, white house.

quiz.say: Which word is an adjective? The sleepy cat sat on the mat.
quiz.show: Which word is an adjective? The sleepy cat sat on the mat.
quiz.why: Sleepy describes the cat, so it is an adjective.

wrong.0: cat is a noun, the thing being described.
wrong.1: sat is a verb, what the cat did.

quiz.say: Mount Everest is the blank mountain in the world.
quiz.show: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
quiz.why: Comparing all the mountains in the world needs est: highest.

wrong.2: Short adjectives use est, not most.
